objective: 在已批准的二维卡通动物风格下，给首章运输与入园安置制作一套可拆分、可落地的游戏界面和背景视觉候选；重点验证真实熊猫与棋盘/托盘/背景的协调性，不做正式游戏代码。

approved_panda.handling: Read unchanged only if accessible and verifiable; else use unmistakably labeled placeholder in concept. Never regenerate/recolor/modify already approved panda as substitute.

constraints.target_layout_compact: 800x600 constraints as spatial/safe-zone note, not necessarily second finished scene render
constraints.target_board_content: 3x2 minimum, 6x5 pressure sample; 1–6 pieces; these are non-frozen G0 candidates
constraints.theme: 动物园首章：运输与入园安置；温暖活泼的入园安置台背景
constraints.style: V1.4 cartoon: dark bold smooth outlines, warm clear color blocks, exaggerated playful forms; no realistic fur or movie CG default
constraints.rights: Original layout and illustration; never trace or reuse Dogs Organized Neatly assets/UI/levels

in_scope: Produce ONE complete, visually legible game-screen candidate with background, board, tray, title, progress, feedback, rotate/reset controls and unobstructed puzzle focus
Provide independent background design and separation plan; draw canvas board/grid/buttons with parameters rather than demanding many baked PNGs
Provide minimal UI styling notes: palette, outlines, board readability, button affordances, whitespace, accessible feedback
Annotate safe zones for 6x5 board and 6 draggable animals plus a practical compact desktop layout behavior
Attach exact version ID, whether approved panda original was actually accessible, unsolved art/UI risks and user G3 review request
out_of_scope: Changing gameplay shape occupancy, level layout or current user-approved panda
Generating extra animal species, entire animal library, storyboard or many background variants
Implementing Canvas/HTML/CSS code or testing browser G4
Assuming visual mockup is interactive/game-ready binary, asking user to manually upload files to GitHub
Permanent fold/unfold trays, elaborate transitional animations, 3D scenery, new engine or detailed choice UI
Freeze release size (8 levels/5 animals still G0 candidate)

deliverables.concept_preview: One versioned visual concept at desktop primary aspect; artwork medium subject to generation capability
deliverables.component_plan: Concise list: 1 environment art layer, program-drawn grid/frame/tray/controls, optional small decoration only if necessary
deliverables.safe_zone_spec: 6x5 board / 6 pieces stress layout and 800x600 compact adaptation notes
deliverables.human_visual_review: PASS_CANDIDATE_READY_FOR_HUMAN | BLOCKED with exact visual version and 1–2 actual choices

acceptance: Main board remains visually dominant at 1280x720; tray and bottom actions do not overlap
Art direction matches current V1.4 cartoon style, not superseded film-CG brief
Background has clear low-noise board/tray zones; no baked grid/button/character source imagery
Actual approved panda is either used unchanged from verified data or honestly shown as placeholder
ART can identify which visual elements genuinely need image bytes and which Codex can draw
No illusion of final content approval; one concept alone does not constitute release-ready UI
next_owner_action: ART posts visual candidate in its own page for HUMAN approval; submit linked GitHub text handoff. After user visual approval, DESIGN issues single-owner Codex UI implementation task; no automatic cross-chat wakeup.
source_note: One-page contract-safe art request, not a replacement production contract.
